dismissed.title: Comma-separated event values still pass validation
dismissed.reason: WebhookType defines only 1, 2 and 3 (WebhookType.cs), so any comma combination of members gives a defined member (1|2=3) and any combination with an undefined value fails Enum.IsDefined (WebhookSubscriptionRequest.cs:23); no undefined event can be stored any more. Comma lists were already accepted b

dismissed.title: Redundant bug-id-named scenario with no data
dismissed.reason: The pipeline requires a scenario per story, named after the lowercased ticket key (scripts/pipeline/lib/tickets.mjs:41 scenario: key.toLowerCase(); qe-automation.agent.md:18). The file extends webhooks-subscriptions instead of duplicating rows and documents why. The finding's own exception applies.
